claims.claim: the WHOLE real internet net (1,914,915 sites, union of two independent top-1M lists) is flowed for real via the T67 index - 449 s/step where the all-pairs D would be 58670 GB; consensus spacing rises across the population
self-healing at full population: killing 20% (382,983 sites) and one local heal step recovers consensus spacing (+7.8%) across 1,531,932 survivors

the honest high-dim wall is measured: 128D-native flow on a real 10,000-site slice costs 19.1 s/step (all-pairs D 102 GB) - the crease-#22 tree degradation that keeps 128D-native flow near 10^4 and justifies the 2D projection as the flow geometry

limits.flow_geometry_is_2d_projection: the whole internet is flowed in the PCA(2) projection of its real 128D embeddings (~11% of variance); the 128D native space is the routing/embedding space (T55i) and its flow stays near 10^4 (crease #22)
limits.one_machine: this is still one 31.7 GB box (T20/T67); a true distributed flow across machines remains unbuilt
limits.sequential_flow: flow keeps its Gauss-Seidel per-neuron loop (identical to T67; a vectorized Jacobi update would change the dynamics)

verdict: SUPPORTED (measured, one machine): the real 1.91M-site internet net is flowed at ~458 s/step via the T67 grid index where all-pairs D would be 58,670 GB; a 20% kill self-heals consensus spacing across 1.53M survivors (+7.8%); and the 128D-native wall is measured at ~16 s/step on 10k real sites (crease #22) - honest limits: 2D projection is the flow geometry, sequential one-machine flow
